newsitem.title: FRANCE: Council of Europe assembly backs Aromanian culture.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe assembly backs Aromanian culture.

text.p: The Council of Europe's Parliamentary Assembly urged Balkan states on Tuesday to take steps to protect and promote the language and culture of their region's Aromanian minority.
An assembly report said 500,000 to 1.5 million Aromanians lived in the region, spread primarily across Albania, Bulgaria, Greece and Macedonia.
The group trace their origins to a Romanian colonisation of the Balkans three centuries ago, and speak a dialect of Romanian.
Socialist deputy Lluis-Maria de Puig of Spain, whose report was accepted by the council, said recognising the group's cultural rights would not threaten the fragile stability of the region.
